about_short_description.short_description: Commerce Layer is a fast, flexible, and secure REST API that lets you add e-commerce to any website, and mobile applications.

product.name: Commerce Layer Links
product.description: A no-code tool that lets users import inventory, connect payment gateways, and sell products anywhere via shareable URLs without needing a website or integrations.

product.name: Drop-in Library
product.description: A set of open-source React components and code snippets that add hosted shopping cart and checkout functionality to any website or frontend framework.

product.name: Commerce Layer APIs & Webhooks
product.description: A comprehensive set of REST API endpoints and real-time webhooks that enable building and managing any ecommerce business model with flexible integrations.

product.name: My Account Application
product.description: A React-based customer account application that manages orders and addresses, providing out-of-the-box account functions for ecommerce stores.

product.name: Rules Engine
product.description: An API-driven engine that allows creation and management of complex promotional rules and discounts tailored to specific business needs.

product.name: Microstores
product.description: React-based applications that create dedicated, configurable landing pages for selected products, accessible via unique URLs without development effort.
